summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The BBH Select Mid Cap ETF (BBHM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital growth through investments in mid-capitalization companies worldwide. Security selection follows a fundamental buy-and-hold strategy. BBHM was launched on Nov 17, 2025 and is issued by BBH.

holdings.infoBox: BBHM is an equity ETF with a total of 30 individual holdings. The top holdings are Entegris stock at 4.84%, Darling Ingredients at 4.81%, Arista Networks at 4.80%, Guidewire Software at 4.72%, and CBRE Group at 4.53%.
